rules.why: a plane: the floor

rules.name: (^|_)(pond|water)$
rules.why: water (visual only): the lowest level, the ground

rules.name: ^(disc|raft)_(stripe|band|hub)
rules.why: a turntable's and the raft's painted stripes, edge band and hub (visual only): on the walkable top

rules.name: ^(ice_\d+_\d+_(crack\d+|tint)|dock_(crack\d+|planks|tint))$
rules.why: Cracked Ice's panels' and the dock's tint, cracks and planks (visual only): on the walkable top
a flat visual-only marking on the floor (sand, lines, a ring on the floor): the ground
a flat visual-only marking on a raised top (the Sumo ring line, a finish line on a course): the platform

rules.name: ^wheel_
rules.why: the Hamster wheel's drum (rim, lips, side disc): moves on its own

rules.name: ^(disc|raft)$
rules.why: Lazy Susan's and Saucer's turntable disc, Wobbly Raft's raft: moving, but walked on

rules.name: ^(ice_\d+_\d+|tile_\d+_\d+|dock)$
rules.why: Cracked Ice's panels and dock, Hex-a-duck's and Crumbling Bridge's tiles: walked on, sink when they go

rules.name: ^ninja_plank\d*(_mid|_end[01])?$
rules.why: Seesaw Race's seesaw planks and their painted pivot line and ends: moving, but walked on

rules.name: ^(mz|dm)_
rules.why: Maze's and Duck-Man's hedges (rise and sink on a slide)

rules.name: ^(step_|ramp|chute$|chute_top$|bridge_)
rules.why: stair treads (Ducky Steps, Stair Shove, Tide Chase, Chained Ducks), ramps, the chute, bridges and their pads

rules.name: ^sweeper_post$
rules.why: the Sweeper's hub post on its deck

rules.name: ^rough
rules.why: the trainer's rough-floor tiles

rules.name: (^|_)kerb
rules.why: kerbs (the trainer's)

rules.name: (^|_)block
rules.why: the trainer's blocks
on a joint or mocap: cars, balls, cups, the loaf, the log, the roomba, the sweeper's bar and wall, cannon balls, thrown things
flush with the floor (a run-out strip, floor tiles)
thin and tall: boards, lane walls, goal sides, maze walls, a dune ridge
low and narrow: hurdle bars, kerbs, low dividers, low boxes
a raised surface wide enough to stand on: stages, decks, tables, tiers, banks
